description: Make an expiring link the customer opens with no account and uses to send photos or videos for one job. The link lasts days (1 to 14, default 7). Each file is saved as provided_by customer and channel upload, with the same size limits, type checks, and location handling as a shop upload: the shop keeps camera details, and copies that leave the shop have them removed. Pass customer_id to name the customer, or leave it out to use the job's customer.
name: media_requestCustomerUpload
